title: Reproducibility depends on the mcp>=2.0.0 API surface (MCPServer, mcp.Client)
evidence: brazilian_soccer/server.py:32 `from mcp.server import MCPServer` and tests/test_mcp_server.py:21 `from mcp import Client`; pyproject.toml pins `mcp>=2.0.0`. mcp was pip-installed at run time and 529 tests passed (test_coverage=0.95), but this API differs from the more common FastMCP/ClientSession surface, so the suite will not run without that specific mcp major version.
suggestion: Pin an upper bound on mcp (e.g. >=2,<3) and document the required API so re-scoring is reproducible.

title: Large solution for the task — low token/effort efficiency
evidence: 12 source modules / 4595 non-blank source LOC + 1953 test LOC; run cost $45.34, 3597s, 39 turns, 13.75M tokens (retort.db _cost_usd/_duration_seconds/_turns/_tokens). scores.json token_efficiency=0.28.
suggestion: None required — the spec is fully met; noted for cross-run efficiency comparison at effort=xhigh.
